title: Meteor HIIT
description: Explosive intervals with squat jumps, tuck jumps and broad jumps for a high-intensity cardio blast

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Brisk march in place
exercises.instructions: March briskly in place while swinging your arms

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching your back, breathe

exercises.name: Moderate high knees
exercises.instructions: Knees to chest at a moderate pace

exercises.name: Squat jumps
exercises.instructions: Explosive squat with a maximum jump, cushion the landing

exercises.name: Tuck jumps
exercises.instructions: Jump while pulling your knees toward your chest

exercises.name: High knees
exercises.instructions: Run in place, knees above hips, arms coordinated

exercises.name: Broad jumps
exercises.instructions: Standing long jumps, cushion the landing and repeat

exercises.name: Pop squats
exercises.instructions: Jump feet apart into a squat, jump feet back together

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
